description: Score the guard. Mode 'guard' (default) runs the bundled labeled case set through aegis_check_output and returns a per-signature scorecard with detection rates, false positives, and latency. Mode 'corpus' runs the paper's keyword classifier over a JSONL incident file (default: the bundled sample) and compares the distribution with the paper's published §3.3 totals.

cases_file.description: Path to a JSONL labeled case file (guard mode). Default: bundled eval/cases.jsonl.

corpus_file.description: Path to a JSONL incident file with {id, source, text} per line (corpus mode). Default: bundled eval/sample-corpus.jsonl.

name: aegis_run_eval
